# MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology

> MIT is a world-leading research university advancing science, technology, and innovation through cutting-edge research, education, and entrepreneurship.

MIT comprises five schools and numerous departments spanning engineering, science, management, architecture, and humanities. The institution serves as a hub for groundbreaking research in AI, biotechnology, photonics, and other fields while maintaining a vibrant campus community in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

## Core Information

- [MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology](https://web.mit.edu): MIT homepage featuring research highlights, news, and institution overview.
- [About MIT](https://web.mit.edu/about): MIT history, facts, institutional leadership, and global community overview.
- [Visit MIT](https://web.mit.edu/visitmit): Visitor information, campus tours, transportation, and welcome center.

## Education & Admissions

- [Education](https://web.mit.edu/education): Overview of MIT's undergraduate and graduate education programs across schools.
- [Admissions + Aid](https://web.mit.edu/admissions-aid): Undergraduate, graduate, and professional admissions and financial aid information.
- [Learn with MIT](http://learn.mit.edu): Online learning platform with courses in AI, machine learning, and robotics.

## Research & Innovation

- [Research](https://web.mit.edu/research): MIT research overview covering 30 departments, labs, centers, and partnerships.
- [Innovation](https://web.mit.edu/innovation): MIT innovation ecosystem with entrepreneurship resources and startup support.
- [MIT Mathematics](https://math.mit.edu): MIT Department of Mathematics faculty awards and research recognition.

## Research Breakthroughs

- [Can AI help predict which heart-failure patients will worsen within a year?](http://news.mit.edu/2026/can-ai-help-predict-which-heart-failure-patients-will-worsen-0312): Deep learning model for heart failure patient trajectory prediction.
- [New sensor sniffs out pneumonia on a patient's breath](http://news.mit.edu/2026/new-sensor-sniffs-out-pneumonia-patients-breath-0316): PlasmoSniff sensor technology for rapid pneumonia diagnosis.
- [New photonic device efficiently beams light into free space](http://news.mit.edu/2026/new-photonic-device-efficiently-beams-light-free-space-0311): Photonic devices for quantum computing and optical communications.
- [New model predicts how mosquitoes will fly](http://news.mit.edu/2026/new-model-predicts-how-mosquitoes-will-fly-0318): Research on mosquito flight patterns and pest control strategies.

## News & Media

- [MIT News](https://news.mit.edu): MIT News homepage with research achievements and institute announcements.
- [Podcast: Curiosity Unbounded, Episode 18 — Inside Efficient AI](http://news.mit.edu/podcast/podcast-curiosity-unbounded-episode-18-inside-efficient-ai-gpus-gpts): Podcast featuring Song Han on efficient AI and GPU optimization.

## Community & Engagement

- [Campus Life](https://web.mit.edu/campus-life): Student organizations, residential life, athletics, and campus traditions at MIT.
